Exact five-process boundary evidence reduces currentGID reach 48.38%-99.96%, proving the ABI is causal rather than a rejected global mechanism. The next general candidate is activation for loaded graphs containing spawn, with Binary Trees as an established newly reached target guard and 39 spawn-free applications as zero-reach guards; a global default remains forbidden.
